description: One source of System knowledge: its current text (a system prompt as written, with its placeholders; the tools; a document), its versions, the runs that ran on them, and the knowledge items its current version states. version shows an older version's text instead, and compare_to adds a unified diff from that version to the one shown, as the Sources tab's Diff does. Long texts are cut at max_chars.

compare_to.description: Also return a unified diff from this version to the one shown, by its number (for example the version before it).
compare_to.title: Compare To

max_chars.description: Most characters of the text (or the diff) to return; the rest is cut.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

source.description: The source's id, as list_sources shows it.
source.title: Source

version.description: Show this version's text instead of the current one, by its number.
version.title: Version

name: get_source
